title: Stock Availability Terms for Orders Awaiting a Shipment
content:
Where the item on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment is not in stock, the wait is governed by the
terms of the fulfilment service the order was placed under. The notice days are the days within which the customer is
told the item has gone to backorder. The backorder days are the days an order may sit awaiting stock before the customer may cancel without
charge. The price hold column states whether the price is held while the item is on backorder. The partial column
states whether lines in stock are sent before the rest. The substitution column states whether a like model may be
sent where the item is discontinued.

| Fulfilment service | Told within, days | Days awaiting stock before cancellation without charge | Price held while awaiting stock | Lines in stock sent before the rest | Like model may be sent where the item is discontinued |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 2 | 30 | yes | yes | no |
| Store Pickup Hold | 1 | 14 | yes | no | no |
| Threshold Delivery | 2 | 45 | yes | yes | yes |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 2 | 45 | yes | no | yes |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 1 | 60 | yes | no | yes |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 1 | 90 | yes | yes | yes |

## How the five columns sit together

The price is held on all six services. The days awaiting stock run from 14 on Store Pickup Hold up to 90 on Business
Dock and Freight Delivery, with 30 on the parcel service, 45 on the two two-person home services and 60 on White
Glove Delivery and Installation. Three services send the lines in stock before the rest: Standard Parcel Delivery,
Threshold Delivery and Business Dock and Freight Delivery. Four allow a like model where the item is discontinued:
Threshold Delivery, Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away, White Glove Delivery and Installation and Business Dock
and Freight Delivery.
